overall: The AG found two violations (no roll-call vote and no stated purpose for entering executive session), both de minimis and unintentional; resolved by informal action with a compliance order.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the board entered executive session using an improper procedure, namely without a proper roll-call vote.
allegations.key_passage: We find the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to vote by roll-call to enter into executive session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the board convened an executive session without giving a proper purpose.
allegations.key_passage: We also find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to state a purpose for the executive session prior to meeting behind closed doors.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: Accordingly, we order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
